templates.statBuff: Temporarily increase {stat} by {percent}% per stack. Max {max} stacks, or {upgradeMax} when upgraded. Lose {decrease} stack at the start of the user's turn.
templates.statDebuff: Temporarily reduce {stat} by {percent}% per stack. Max {max} stacks, or {upgradeMax} when upgraded. Lose {decrease} stack at the end of the user's turn.
templates.elementalDamage: Consume all {element} elements. For each stack consumed, deal {percent}% {element} damage based on your strongest attribute. If the specific condition is met, trigger {finale}.
templates.statusBurn: For each stack, take {percent}% damage based on MaxHP at the start of turn and receive more damage from Fire attacks. Newly received stacks deal their damage immediately if inflicted during the user's turn. Max {max} stacks, or {upgradeMax} when upgraded. Removed at the end of each turn.
templates.elementCore: Each {element} element stack uses the shared element rules: {damageBonus}% non-elemental damage bonus per stack under its matching condition, {reduction}% elemental damage reduction per stack, max {max} stacks or {upgradeMax} when upgraded, and loses {loseStacks} stack when countered by {counteredBy}.
templates.elementAbilityCore: Increase damage dealt and healing by {stackBonus}% for each {element} element on self. The matching conditional damage bonus is {conditionalBonus}%, or {upgradedConditionalBonus}% when upgraded.
templates.elementFinale: If an elemental attack consumes {threshold} or more {element} element stacks, deal an extra {damage}% {element} damage based on your strongest attribute. If {maxThreshold} stacks are consumed, deal {maxDamage}% instead.
